<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/returns"}

Lists the RMAs whose orderRef matches `orderRef`, newest first. An
unknown order answers `200` with `[]`, never `404`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

>
